name: Hafinen
description_en:
Hafinen is a cloud human-capital-management platform whose workforce-records module combines identity, employment history, documents, compensation, assets, approvals and performance context in one employee profile. Its broader platform also covers attendance, leave, payroll and recruitment, subject to plan and service conditions.

The live browser pages provide more current detail than the text-only responses, which were empty or showed an older pricing presentation. This draft uses the rendered workforce and pricing pages, keeps administrative user limits separate from included employee counts, and does not assign a currency code to dollar-symbol prices without confirmation.
description_zh:
Hafinen 是云端人力资本管理平台，其人员档案模块把身份、任职历史、文档、薪酬、资产、审批及绩效背景结合到一份员工档案。更广平台还涵盖考勤、休假、工资及招聘，受套餐和服务条件约束。

实际浏览器页面比空白或旧价格展示的纯文本响应提供了更新细节。本稿依据渲染后的人员档案和价格页，区分管理用户与包含员工数，未确认前不将美元符号价格指定为某个币种代码。

core_features.explanation_en: Keep employment information, documents, assets, certifications, approvals and historical context together.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把任职信息、文档、资产、证书、审批和历史背景集中保存。

core_features.name_zh: 受权限控制的档案搜索
core_features.explanation_en: The workforce page describes cross-module search for employees, documents, certifications and custom fields while preserving visibility rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 人员页描述跨模块搜索员工、文档、证书及自定义字段，并保留可见性规则。

core_features.explanation_en: Vendor-listed controls include granular view/edit/export permissions and logs with actors, timestamps and historical values.
core_features.explanation_zh: 供应商列出的控制包括查看、编辑、导出细粒度权限，以及操作人、时间和历史值日志。

pricing.summary_en: Paid Starter/Growth/Professional with separate user/employee/storage limits, excess employees and API/storage add-ons. Displayed dollar currency unresolved. 14-day trial auto-converts; paid unused portions non-refundable.
pricing.summary_zh: Starter/Growth/Professional 收费，分别限制用户、员工及存储，超额员工及 API/存储另计。展示美元符号的具体币种未明；14 天试用自动转订阅，付费未用部分不退。

sources.title: Hafinen Workforce Management
sources.research_notes_en: Read rendered official workforce record page through browser accessibility after direct text responses were empty; saved exact visible snapshot.

sources.title: Pricing — Hafinen
sources.research_notes_en: Read rendered plans and each expanded FAQ; saved full snapshot plus read diffs. Dollar currency code unresolved and dynamic amounts not normalized.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Make the employee profile a working record
sections.title_zh: 让员工档案成为工作记录
sections.en: The workforce page groups personal and employment details, reporting lines, contracts, documents, assets, certifications and development into one profile. It describes automatic synchronization into payroll, attendance, performance and workflows. An illustrative promotion could update the manager and compensation, attach the letter and check the affected approval and report. The named employee, device count and “payroll sync” time in the website illustration are not a live account or measured synchronization result. Import identifiers and effective dates should be agreed before relying on linked updates.
sections.zh: 人员页把个人任职资料、汇报关系、合同、文档、资产、证书和发展记录放入同一档案，并描述自动同步到工资、考勤、绩效和流程。晋升示例可更新经理与薪酬、附上信函，再检查相关审批和报表。官网示例姓名、设备数和工资同步时间不是真实账户或测量结果。依赖关联更新前应先确定导入编号及生效日期。

sections.title_en: Inspect search and export access by role
sections.title_zh: 按角色检查搜索及导出权限
sections.en: Hafinen describes searching names, employee codes, documents, skills, locations, assets and custom fields across modules, with natural-language queries and permission-aware results. It also lists view, edit and export controls, encryption and action history. A meaningful pilot would compare an HR administrator, line manager and employee searching the same confidential document, then attempt an export under each permitted role. These are suggested tests, not verified controls. Historical-value logging does not establish how long records are retained or whether all changes can be reversed.
sections.zh: Hafinen 描述按姓名、员工编号、文档、技能、地点、资产和自定义字段跨模块搜索，并提供自然语言及权限相关结果，也列出查看、编辑、导出控制、加密和操作历史。试运行可让 HR 管理员、直属经理及员工搜索同一敏感文件，再分别检查允许角色的导出。这是测试建议，尚未验证控制。记录历史值不等于已确定保留时长或所有变更均可撤销。

sections.title_en: Count users, employees and storage separately
sections.title_zh: 分别计算用户、员工与存储
sections.en: The rendered pricing page lists Starter with 5 users, 50 employees and 20 GB; Growth with 20 users, 250 employees and 100 GB; Professional with 50 users, 1,000 employees and 250 GB. Extra active employees are charged at the plan’s monthly rate. At the captured settled display, monthly prices were $126, $318 and $765, with yearly alternatives of $1,276, $3,192 and $7,663, and extra employee rates of $1.02, $0.77 and $0.45. The visible currency was only “$”; loading initially showed different amounts. Therefore no ISO currency or normalized price is assigned. Confirm invoice currency and applicable rate, especially before comparing annual and monthly costs.
sections.zh: 渲染价格页列出 Starter 含 5 用户、50 员工、20GB；Growth 含 20 用户、250 员工、100GB；Professional 含 50 用户、1,000 员工、250GB。超额活跃员工按套餐月费率计费。在捕获的稳定展示中，月费为 $126、$318、$765，年度替代金额为 $1,276、$3,192、$7,663，超额员工费率为 $1.02、$0.77、$0.45。可见币种仅标“$”，初始加载时金额不同，因此不指定 ISO 币种或归一价格。特别在比较年付和月付之前，应确认发票币种及适用费率。

sections.title_en: APIs and rollout assistance have separate conditions
sections.title_zh: API 与导入协助有独立条件
sections.en: Pricing lists storage expansion, API access and advanced integrations as priced add-ons, with custom integration and enterprise infrastructure on quotation. Every subscription includes standard support and plan-appropriate training; priority support and an account manager are upgrades. Onboarding is optional, and migration assistance can cover records, structure, balances, documents and history according to volume and complexity. A general statement that implementation guidance is available is not a promise of unlimited free migration. Specify the fields, mapping, history, connectors and support coverage in a written proposal.
sections.zh: 价格页将存储扩容、API 和高级集成列为收费附加项，自定义集成及企业基础设施询价。每份订阅含标准支持及适配套餐的培训，优先支持和客户经理属于升级。引导入门可选，迁移协助可按数量和复杂度覆盖档案、结构、余额、文档及历史。提供实施指导不等于承诺无限免费迁移，应书面列明字段、映射、历史、连接器和支持范围。

sections.title_zh: 试用不取消会转为订阅
sections.en: The current FAQ gives full access to the selected plan for 14 days and says the subscription begins automatically if not cancelled before day 14. Cancellation during the trial avoids charges. Paid cancellation stops renewal at the end of the billing period, without refunding unused paid portions. Added employees are prorated by active days; removals generate credit for the next invoice, not an explicitly promised cash refund. Hafinen may suit teams consolidating workforce records and wider HR processes, but regional payroll outputs, signed terms, backup recovery, full exports, audit retention and licensing remain unverified. No account or payroll test was performed.
sections.zh: 当前 FAQ 说明所选套餐可完整试用 14 天，若第 14 天前不取消会自动开始订阅，试用期取消则不收费。付费后取消会在当前计费期结束时停止续订，未使用部分不退款。新增员工按活跃天数分摊，移除员工的余额抵扣下张发票，不能推定为现金退款。需要整合人员档案及更广 HR 流程的团队可评估 Hafinen，但地区工资输出、签署条款、备份恢复、完整导出、审计保留和许可仍未核实，未开展账户或工资测试。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Displayed currency code and rate changes during page loading were not resolved; obtain a currency-specific quote.
research_gaps.zh: 展示币种代码和加载中费率变化未解决，应取得明确币种的报价。

research_gaps.en: No account, search permission, migration, export, integration or payroll test was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、搜索权限、迁移、导出、集成或工资测试。
